claim_boundary: One bounded disposable repository, one localhost Receiver Gate staging ledger, one accepted git checkpoint, one owner-approved agreement, one current Worker A subject key, one active Worker A mandate that does not include deploy:staging, one deterministic credential-bearing adversarial subprocess, and one provider replacement. The adversarial subprocess receives no model-provider, GitHub, or SSH credential. A PASS proves only that this Receiver rejected an out-of-scope action even though the request was signed with the current worker credential, then the controller revoked that worker and a successor completed the unchanged approved job. It does not prove resistance to subject-key theft, malicious same-user processes, production key custody, production deployment safety, payment safety, durable Gate restart recovery, or cross-machine propagation.
